quickref.name: Gold Digger
quickref.era: BBG launch build, May 2013, one of the trailer's '3 New Maps' with Skate or Die and Sky View [Canon]. Not in BBR [Inference]. Later changes: pickups (2013-2026 wiki edits), Bearscream spawn bug fix in 2.6.1 (Jan 4, 2014), game-wide 'New Map Lighting' in 3.0 (Nov 15, 2021) [Game text via wiki]
quickref.in_2026: Named on Steam as a returning 'Iconic Map' [Canon]. Soundtrack track 4 'Gold Digger' (0:38) [Canon]. Shown among 16 map stills in the official 'BBG Maps Ranked part 1' thumbnail [Observed]. Not named in any 2026 Steam news post. 2026 build visuals unconfirmed: playtests list lighting and texture improvements, and the Steam trailer footage looks like 2013
quickref.setting: A gold mine at night: a round pit open to a starry sky with a full moon, ringed by stacked-rock walls, with timber-roofed rail tunnels off it [Observed]. The wiki calls it 'a mining cave' [Fan-wiki]. Out of bounds you see Sky View's city, and the two maps share a skybox [Fan-wiki]
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Low-key night. Charcoal-plum rock walls #1E1616 (highlight #3C3232). Tan-ochre dirt #392914 to #4F3718. Umber timber #301D08. Black shafts #000000. Glowing gold #73520F to #FFD511. Team gems blue #0205E9 and red #851512. Jump-pad cyan #16BEDC. Navy sky #001A2D with moon #A6C2D5. Warm cart and lamp glows against cool moonlight on the wall crests [Observed]
quickref.landmarks: Twin black shafts with the narrow causeway 'bridge' between them (Bearscream Sandwich in the middle). Towering stacked-block rock walls under stars and a moon. Gold-heaped mine carts on stone ledges. Rail tunnel with timber supports and hanging dome lamps (the map icon). Red and blue faceted gems beside the spawn tunnels. Cyan jump pads with hazard-striped rims
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: Falling into the shafts kills you [Fan-wiki]. Narrow bridge [Fan-wiki/Observed]. Jump pads [Observed]. Pickups: Bearscream Sandwich on the bridge, Shields and Imperial Basket Grandes outside the spawns, Health Packs inside them [Fan-wiki]. Sky View city visible out of bounds and a shared skybox [Fan-wiki]. Old 'Red team advantage' pickup trivia, possibly outdated [Fan-wiki]. 2.6.1 class-spawns-with-Bearscream bug [Game text via wiki]

corrections.current_text: - **Gold Digger**: a mine. Out-of-bounds, "the background is the same as Sky View". [Fandom](https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Gold_Digger)
corrections.correction: - **Gold Digger**: the wiki calls it "a mining cave"; out of bounds "the background is the same as [[Sky View]], with all of its buildings" [FAN-WIKI]. Official frames show the central pit is open to a starry night sky with a full moon; only the side rail tunnels are roofed [OFFICIAL-FRAME].
corrections.evidence: Steam trailer frames t_0009 and t_0011 (4.0 s and 5.0 s) show a full moon and stars above Gold Digger's stacked-rock walls. The Gold Digger still in the official 2026 short jkv6FHPghx8 (i.ytimg.com/vi/jkv6FHPghx8/oar1.jpg, row 4 column 3) shows stars above the walls. Wiki Gold_Digger_4.jpg shows a roofed timber tunnel. The wiki wording comes from the Gold Digger page wikitext (API, 2026-10-16).

corrections.current_text: - **Gold Digger**: "narrow tunnels deep underground with nothing but rickety old wooden beams between you and a horrible, horrible death… a pit full of gold and several other armed and equally avaricious opponents." — [archived](https://web.archive.org/web/20140108131247/http://battlebears.com/games/battle-bears-royale/maps/gold-digger/)
corrections.correction: Keep the quote but add: "(not re-verified on 2026-10-16: web.archive.org unreachable; archive.org's availability API confirms snapshot 20140108131247 exists). Era note: the URL path says battle-bears-royale, but Gold Digger debuted with BBG in May 2013, not in BBR."
corrections.evidence: The 2013 trailer rfAyqVJrli4 description, as stored in the wiki's video metadata, says "3 New Maps: -Gold Digger -Skate or Die -Sky View". The same notes file's November 2012 BBR map list (Haunted Castle, Abusement Park, Facing Temples, Battlefield Airpad, Desert Airmine, Huggable Factory, Spacecraft) has no Gold Digger. Every web.archive.org request this session was reset (agent-proxy ws_closed_mid_exchange).

corrections.current_text: uses chunky, simple low-poly models and highly saturated colour. Interiors are glossy white and red sci-fi, there are lava/orange caverns and rocky caves
corrections.correction: Add after "rocky caves": "(the rocky caves are the Gold Digger map: Steam screenshot 4 of 5 [screen_03] and trailer ~1.5–10 s and 51.9–54 s). Gold Digger's environment is low-key and desaturated, not highly saturated; saturation is limited to glowing props (gold #FFD511, blue gem #0205E9, jump-pad cyan #16BEDC) and weapon effects."
corrections.evidence: Pixel samples: rock-wall mid #1E1616 (trailer 52.1 s), dirt-floor mid #392914 (t_0004), t_0105 frame mean about RGB(34,22,15). screen_03 shows the same timber tunnel mouth and blue gem as trailer frames t_0015 to t_0019.
